frontier.hypothesis: The releasing dependent of the boosted base must be an insn the target ALREADY emits at the slot right after the base, and it must depend on the base at ZERO instruction cost. H51's andi is both the whole 1-insn overage and the reason the base landed one slot early.
frontier.mechanism: schedule_insn releases a max_priority insn when its last dependent is picked, and emission (reverse pick order) then places it immediately before that dependent. If the dependent is one of the three struct stores the target already emits at slots 92-94, the base lands exactly in the target's slot 91 with no added insn.
frontier.next_probe: Make one of s.zero10 / s.one14 / s.ret depend on the base through its ADDRESS rather than its stored value - e.g. reach those members through a pointer local derived from the base, or through a differently-based lvalue GCC's memrefs_conflict_p cannot disambiguate from MEM(sp+32) - starting from s19/dep2/A_gap2_depstore.c, keeping the carrier's def-to-last-use gap at 1-3, and gating every variant on build_insns == 176 before disassembling the 0x3594 window.

frontier.hypothesis: The anti/output direction of the H49 edge has never been spelled: the base insn referencing MEM(s + 0x10) itself, rather than the store referencing the base.
frontier.mechanism: sched.c records an anti-dependence from a later write to an earlier read of the same memory, and GCC 2.7.2's memrefs_conflict_p disambiguates two constant sp offsets - so the base's expression must touch the SAME struct member the store writes for the edge to exist. Unlike the data direction it does not require the store's value to change, so it does not conflict with the target's sw zero,32(sp).
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate base spellings that read s.zero10 (or an aliasing sub-word / union / char-pointer view of it) while still emitting a single addiu <reg>,s4,-K - including forms where the read is folded away by cse but the dependence survives - gate on build_insns == 176, and read BB2_SCHED_DEBUG=1 to confirm whether the dep is recorded and whether the boost still fires.

frontier.hypothesis: (carried) The object model of D_8009B2E0 / D_8009B388 is still the last untried non-spelling axis: a header-canonical aggregate declaration for the 0x3C-stride particle-template table has never been measured on this function, and candidate.c still carries the declaration pun p_b2e0 = (u8 *)&D_8009B2E0.
frontier.mechanism: Which callee-saved register holds which loop base is decided by allocno priority, driven by reg_n_refs; a different declared object model changes the number of references to the pointer locals, and therefore the seats, without changing any statement in the a2 chain.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate header-canonical aggregate declarations for the 0x3C-stride table at D_8009B2E0 and the pair D_8009B388/D_8009B390 (aggregate-merge prong (a) satisfied by the 0x3C stride and the p_b2ec + stride addressing), applied through an integration handoff for the header edit, and sweep the loop's pointer-local spellings against each; gate on build_insns == 176.
